docs.summary: How cameras become views of a frame. Prowl's own, [`ForwardCameraPipeline`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.ForwardCameraPipeline), draws each camera as a Graphite view running the world's features and the camera's effects. A pipeline of another design, such as deferred, adds each camera as an external view ([`BuildView`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Camera~BuildView) with ViewDesc.External set), which Graphite culls and prepares draws for, and records it in passes of its own added with [`AddPipeline`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Graphics), drawing through Renderer.Draws. Set it on [`CameraPipeline`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.CameraPipeline).
